The '''Tetan monarchy''' was the legitimate governing body of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], presided over by the ruling family of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. The monarchy was officially established after the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], when the then-[[Empress/Legends|Empress]] of the then-named [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] unified the system's seven worlds under one banner. To honor Empress [[Teta/Legends|Teta]], the system was renamed for her in tribute after her [[Death/Legends|death]]. From then on her descendants would rule, perpetuating the [[Tetan/Legends|Tetan]] legacy through the generations.

==History==
In the year [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the then-ruler of the what was known as the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]], managed to unify the seven [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] within under her banner. [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] was her name,<ref name="GAOTS" /> and after her [[Death/Legends|death]], the system was renamed in her honor.<ref name="DLOTS" />

More than [[3997 BBY|one thousand years later]], the Empress Teta system was still ruled by the Monarchy set in place by the legendary Empress. Descendants of Teta known as the [[Keto family/Legends|Keto family]] ruled the system now, although violent measures became the norm when maintaining order throughout the [[Tetan/Legends|Tetan]] worlds. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Keto]], the reigning Emperor of Empress Teta, maintained control through use of [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droids]].<ref name="DLOTS" />

That same year, power was wrested from Lord Keto and Lady [[Magda Keto]] (his sister, and also Empress of Teta) by their own children. Lord Keto's son [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]], and Lady Keto's daughter [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] staged a violent [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|governmental coup]] that resulted in the deaths of both the former Lady and Lord Keto. Under the guise of their [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-[[Sith cult/Legends|inspired]] [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], the Satal and his cousin Aleema became the new rulers of the Empress Teta system. The Krath dominion would not last forever. Within a year, both Aleema and Satal had perished. Satal [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|died]] at the hands of a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] on the balcony of the Krath palace, the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]].<ref name="DLOTS" /> Aleema was consumed by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] of her own [[Supernova (Sith magic)|design]], being tricked into creating the catastrophy by the same Jedi that slew her cousin.<ref name="TSW4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 4]]</ref> Despite this, the Tetan legacy was carried on after the deaths of Aleema and Satal Keto, surviving thousands of years into the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], with Emperor [[Alor Keto/Legends|Alor Keto]] ruling over Empress Teta by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
